sentences.text: If you put up four posts and a roof, you have a garden shelter.
But the first wind catches the roof and tips it over.
So you dig down and pour concrete footings under the posts.
But now rain turns the grass under it to mud.
So you lay paving slabs on a compacted sub-base.
But now the wind blows the rain in sideways.
So you add a back wall and a side wall.
A 90 mile per hour wind gust pushes about 20 pounds on every square foot.
Add stepping stones and bushes around it.
Congratulations, you have built a garden shelter.
